gancho: Le pidió matrimonio… con el anillo de otra
estilo: Cinematic Mexican telenovela look, warm dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, emotional close-ups, realistic people, natural Mexican Spanish acting
escenas: Elegant candle-lit restaurant at night. DIEGO (30, short black hair, white dress shirt) kneels beside the table and opens a small velvet ring box toward MARIANA (28, long straight black hair, red dress), who covers her mouth in surprise. Slow push-in. Diego says: "Mariana, ¿te quieres casar conmigo?"

Same restaurant, same moment. MARIANA (28, long straight black hair, red dress) takes the ring, smiling, then tilts it and reads the engraving inside; her smile fades. DIEGO (30, short black hair, white dress shirt) still kneeling, nervous. Close-up on Mariana: "¿Quién es Sofía, Diego?"

Same restaurant. Behind them a WAITRESS (27, hair in a bun, black uniform, name tag) freezes holding a tray, staring at the ring. MARIANA (28, long black hair, red dress) and DIEGO (30, white dress shirt) turn to her. The waitress says coldly: "Soy yo. Y ayer me dio el mismo anillo." Dramatic zoom on Diego's face.
caption: Ella dijo sí… hasta que leyó el anillo 💍 ¿Qué harías tú? #novela #drama #historiascortas #telenovela #giro
